messages:
Tom | Sales: Quick handoff for Crescent Health trial — 15 days left. Region: us-east. PHI involved, BA requested. They want Private deployment + BYOK KMS. Procurement asked for Dedicated + Private pricing by next Tue. Org ID: CH-9002. Demo: https://rwd.inc/demos/crescent-2026. Looping in @Lin to own CS.

Lin | CS: Thanks @Tom — I’ll take lead. Who’s the primary contact and expected load? Any compliance/retention asks beyond BA?

Tom | Sales: Primary: sara@crescent.com (Head of Eng). Baseline ~5k tokens/day, import spikes up to ~40k tokens/day. They requested SAML + SCIM, 2yr audit log retention, and encryption key rotation policy details. POc goal: 90% requests <200ms p50.

handoff-bot: Ticket CH-9002 created: "Crescent Health - Private + SSO + SCIM onboarding". Priority: P1 (POC at risk). Assignees: Priya, Noah, Jae. Link: https://rwd.inc/tickets/CH-9002

Priya | Support: I can start on SAML and SCIM flows. Need IdP metadata + SCIM provisioning creds and a test account. If SAML blocks progress, we can enable API-key access temporarily.

Jae | SE: I'll prep an integration harness and a perf smoke script to run during kickoff. Will add a short sample for tokenization differences. Snippet I'll attach to ticket, example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.rwd/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-clarity-7b","input":"smoke test"}'
```

Noah | Eng: Private deploy notes: we'll need their CIDR ranges, networking contact, and approval for subnet peering. BYOK KMS integration requires their key ARN and rotation policy. Rough estimate: 5 dev-days for connector + 1 day infra setup. If they require 4-bit quantized runtime we'll add QA time. Need model & expected QPS.

Tom | Sales: Model: redwood-clarity-7b. Expected peak QPS ~40, average seq len ~128. They also asked about fallback to open weights for cost control (A/B). Procurement asked for a line-item breakdown.

Lin | CS: Scheduling kickoff Wed 9am PT — invite sent to Sara and their infra lead. Owners: Lin (CS lead), Priya (Support - SSO/SCIM), Noah (Eng - private infra), Jae (SE - integration), Tom (Sales - procurement). I'll add weekly checkpoints and a post-POC feedback survey. Tagging renewal-risk: procurement unresolved in 10 days.

Priya | Support: Noted. Once we have IdP metadata I'll run SAML test and attach logs. If there are mapping issues we'll try SCIM provisioning or fallback API-key for dev testing.

Tom | Sales: Sent IdP metadata and a SCIM service account to Priya (via secure channel). Procurement is coordinating finance for quote; I'll push to meet the deadline.

handoff-bot: CH-9002 updated: legal flagged for BA, network info requested, status: In progress.

Lin | CS: Next steps (also logged in CH-9002): 1) Confirm BA/legal (Tom) 2) Customer sends IdP metadata + SCIM creds (Customer) 3) Networking CIDR + contact (Noah) 4) Quote for Dedicated + Private (Tom + Finance) 5) SE test harness + perf script (Jae). I'll add the survey draft to the ticket to capture post-POC feedback and enablement notes.

Jae | SE: I'll upload the perf script and a short checklist of verification steps to CH-9002 before kickoff. Will also include tokenization sample and sample payloads to reproduce.

Noah | Eng: Acknowledged. I'll create an infra checklist (peering, NAT, routing, KMS policy) and post ETA by EOD tomorrow.

Tom | Sales: Thanks everyone — looping legal & finance privately now. Will update here when procurement confirms.

Lin | CS: Thanks team — leaving this thread open for updates. I'll post kickoff notes and first-week goals after Wed.
